stage_mapping.lexical_similarity_features: Exact match, token/character Jaccard, length ratio, edit similarity, TF-IDF cosine
stage_mapping.embedding_similarity_features: Training-only TF-IDF and truncated SVD cosine/distance
stage_mapping.pair_context_features: Training candidate graph, with current edge excluded for training features
stage_mapping.feature_ensemble: Training-only scaled logistic regression plus64-tree random forest, equal score mean
stage_mapping.metric_thresholding: Held-out binary F1 maximization with highest-threshold tie rule

limits: Explicit binary matching realization; no historical competition accuracy
No external pretrained corpus or spelling correction
Training/calibration/query normalized unordered pairs disjoint; individual texts may recur across splits, no unseen-entity generalization guarantee
Calibration F1 is threshold-selection evidence, not unbiased evaluation or probability calibration
Query duplicates allowed but cannot overlap fitted populations
Two-provider serialized execution verified separately; no catalog publication yet
